description: Ask the Denpex diagnostician a follow-up question about a crash, clarify the fix, explore an alternative, or dig deeper. Pass the original `logs` and your `question`; pass back the `conversationId` from a previous reply to continue the thread. Requires the Team plan or an active trial.

conversationId.description: From a previous reply, to continue the same thread.

history.description: Prior turns of this conversation, oldest first.

logs.description: The original crash logs the question is about.

name: ask_followup
title: Ask a follow-up about a diagnosis
